page: Microsoft Azure E96nds_v6 is an Endv6-family virtual machine configured with 96 dedicated vCPUs on an x86_64 Intel processor architecture. Running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor, this server provides 768.0 GB of system memory, establishing a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. This memory density classifies the instance as a memory-optimized resource designed for memory-intensive enterprise workloads.

The instance features 5669 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, offering high-capacity, low-latency local disk space. It is also Premium Storage capable, allowing integration with high-performance external storage options. The server is designated as network-optimized, supporting demanding data transfer requirements, though it does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses or dedicated GPU hardware.

Given the combination of a high memory-to-vCPU ratio, substantial local NVMe SSD capacity, and network optimization, this server is suited for large-scale databases, in-memory analytics, enterprise resource planning systems, and heavy data processing pipelines. The dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent processing performance without resource contention.
